description: A shared comparable_group_id caused NIKKE and Stellar Blade transformations to be computed in one group.
resolution: Phase D builder now groups by series_id plus comparable_group_id; all affected fields were rebuilt.

description: New peaks could retain positive drawdown values and recovery duration was not measured from the prior peak.
resolution: Drawdown is zero at/above the prior peak; recovery is detected after an active drawdown and duration is recorded within-version.

description: Stable same-series windows were labeled DIRECTLY_COMPARABLE instead of the frozen conservative default.
resolution: All 12 self-window relationships now use WITHIN_SERIES_ONLY.

description: The event layer is curated and non-exhaustive; absence is not evidence that no event occurred.
resolution: Caveat retained in Phase E audit and readiness manifest.

description: Derived title values use official whole-percent shares and therefore retain interval uncertainty.
resolution: Bounds and sensitivity flags are retained for all derived observations.

description: Some official document URLs are attachment or query URLs rather than durable archive permalinks.
source_evidence: Phase E source URL quality audit
resolution: Local hash-verified PDFs and canonical official URLs provide recoverable provenance.

description: Publisher-defined title/IP and platform scopes differ, so cross-series absolute revenue ranking remains forbidden.
resolution: Comparability matrix remains conservative and findings-ready rows retain scope identifiers.
